item.title: PDRN leads Korea's rising beauty searches, +52% vs. the prior four weeks
item.description: K-Beauty rising: PDRN (+52%), Toner pads (+18%), Retinol (+3%) K-Beauty cooling most: Sun stick (-44%) K-Food rising: Nurungji (scorched rice) (+21%), Seaweed chips (gim-bugak) (+9%), Yakgwa (honey cookie) (+3%) K-Food cooling most: Frozen gimbap (-39%)
